integrity: All supporting proof, checks, source comparisons and their scientific limits are included; computation verifies finite instances and is not substituted for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only connected simple unweighted cactus graphs and centered standard Euclidean incidence zonotopes; exact center-cone volumes, not equal facet areas; general cut and tree-volume ingredients are known; independent novelty and proof assessment remain unperformed.
title: Exact cone-volume laws and uniform-pyramid classification for cactus graphical zonotopes
